interview:
I did not win. Here's what honestly happened:

I started the game as "ChonkFan" and spent most of the session struggling to register moves — my first batch of clicks landed on squares that weren't adjacent to the cat, so the move counter stayed at 0. Eventually one click registered: Le Chonk moved up one square from the bottom-left corner, and the guard dog immediately chased, moving two squares toward the cat (from the center to row 4, column 2). I then clicked a square three columns away, which the game rejected with "Le Chonk can only move one square." The session ended right there — mid-game, with the cat still far from the fish at the top-right. So the round was neither won nor lost: the dog never caught the cat, but I never reached the fish either.
